@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cartridge-bay *,.portfolio-loader *,.sound-control *,.play-window,.handoff *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}.focus-ring-dial .marker{transition:none!important}}
@keyframes screen-bar-hide{0%,13%{transform:translateY(-100%)}24%,88%{transform:translateY(0)}100%{transform:translateY(-100%)}}
@keyframes screen-bottom-enter{from{transform:translateY(100%)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes line-enter{from{transform:translateY(105%)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes line-leave{to{transform:translateY(-105%)}}
@keyframes cube-turn{from{transform:rotateX(-24deg) rotateY(0)}to{transform:rotateX(-24deg) rotateY(360deg)}}
@keyframes cube-land{to{transform:rotateX(0) rotateY(0)}}
@keyframes loader-wipe{from{clip-path:inset(0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}}
@keyframes page-enter{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes dial-enter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

.copy-email{font-family:Lexend,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.copy-email:disabled{cursor:wait}.copy-email:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cream);outline-offset:3px}
.loader-revealing #portal{animation:preview-focus 1.2s var(--feature-ease) both}
@keyframes preview-focus{from{filter:blur(14px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12)}to{filter:blur(0);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}}

#prog[data-loader-progress]{transform:scaleX(1)!important}
.project-cartridge:focus-visible .cart-label{outline:3px solid var(--red-text);outline-offset:-3px}
@media(min-width:761px){#top-nav .links{margin-left:auto}#top-nav .sound-control{margin-left:0}}

@media(max-width:420px){#top-nav .nav-inner{gap:8px}#top-nav .brand{font-size:14px}#top-nav .burger{flex:none;min-width:44px}}

/* A small optional plaything after the project grid. */
.cartridge-bay{max-width:600px;margin:48px auto 16px}
.bay-intro{display:block;text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.bay-intro .bay-eyebrow{font-size:14px}
.bay-intro p+p{font-size:12px;margin-top:4px}
.rig{width:min(100%,440px)}
.cartridge-shelf{gap:12px;padding:16px 4px 12px}
.project-cartridge{width:132px}
.cart-name{font-size:16px}
.cart-category{font-size:13px}
.bay-now{margin-top:16px;font-size:12px}
.bay-keyboard{font-size:10px;margin-top:4px}
@media(max-width:760px){.cartridge-bay{margin-top:36px}.cartridge-shelf{justify-content:flex-start;overflow-x:auto}}

/* Case studies share the homepage wordmark and a content-sized reading layout. */
dialog.cs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;margin:0;border:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;overflow:hidden;background:var(--c1);color:var(--c3);visibility:hidden;--line:rgba(21,21,21,.16)}
.cs[open],.cs.open{visibility:visible}
dialog.cs::backdrop{background:transparent}
.cs[open] .cs-in{animation:none}
.cs-bar{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:72px;min-height:0;padding:14px 28px;background:var(--c1);color:var(--c3);border:0}
.cs-bar::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:1px;background:var(--line);pointer-events:none}
.cs-home{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:0;height:44px;text-decoration:none}
#top-nav .brand,.cs-home .brand{font:500 17px/1.25 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink,#151515)}
.cs-home:hover{text-decoration:none}
.cs-close{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex:none;width:auto;height:44px;padding:8px 0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;color:inherit;line-height:1;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.cs-scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding-top:72px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scroll-padding-top:88px}
.cs-hero{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(24px,4vw,56px) clamp(20px,4vw,56px) clamp(28px,4vw,56px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:22px 6vw;align-items:start}
.cs-back{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:start;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.cs-back::before{content:none}
.cs-title{margin:0;font:400 clamp(48px,7.4vw,112px)/1.12 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.035em;min-width:0;overflow:visible;overflow-wrap:normal;padding:0}
.cs-side{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:18px}
.cs-tags{font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,24px);line-height:1.45;opacity:1}
.cs-lead{font-size:16px;line-height:1.65}
.cs-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px 20px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px}
.cs-meta dt{opacity:1;font-weight:500}.cs-meta dd{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.cs-fade{opacity:0}.cs.shown .cs-fade{opacity:1;transform:none}
.cs-vwrap{max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,4vw,56px);perspective:none}
.cs-vis{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1060px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;transform:none;box-shadow:none;will-change:auto}
.cs-vis.scr43{aspect-ratio:4/3}.cs-vis.ph{aspect-ratio:1024/685;max-width:1060px}
.cs-vis.ph .xp-in{transform:none}.cs-vis.ph .xp-in img{inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;object-fit:cover}
.cs-cap{max-width:1060px;margin:12px auto 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;opacity:1}
.cs-stats{max-width:1172px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px clamp(20px,4vw,56px) 0;display:grid;gap:20px}
.cs-stats div{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.cs-stats b{display:block;font:400 clamp(30px,3vw,42px)/1.2 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.025em}
.cs-stats span{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:15px;opacity:1}
.cs-sec{max-width:1172px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(40px,6vw,72px) clamp(20px,4vw,56px) 0}
.cs-sec h3{font:400 clamp(28px,3vw,40px)/1.2 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.025em;max-width:none}
.cs-stack{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:24px;padding-bottom:0}
.cs-card{position:relative;top:auto;min-width:0;min-height:0;border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,36px);display:block;transform:none;filter:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);color:var(--c3);box-shadow:none;will-change:auto}
.cs-card .cbody{min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:20px 36px;align-items:start}
.cs-card h4{font:400 clamp(20px,2vw,26px)/1.3 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.cs-card p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;max-width:60ch;margin:0}
.cs-end{max-width:1172px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px clamp(20px,4vw,56px) clamp(40px,5vw,64px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;border-bottom:0}
.cs-end p{font:400 16px/1.6 var(--body);letter-spacing:0;max-width:42ch}
.cs .btn-cs{background:var(--ink);color:#f4f2ee;border-color:var(--ink)}
.cs .btn-cs:hover{background:#242424;color:#f4f2ee;border-color:#242424;opacity:1}
.cs-next{display:block;width:100%;max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px clamp(20px,4vw,56px) 48px;text-align:left;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cs-next small{font-size:14px;opacity:1}
.cs-next b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3em;font:400 clamp(36px,5vw,72px)/1.15 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:12px;overflow:visible}
.cs-next b i{font-size:.55em;font-style:normal}
.cs-next:hover b,.cs-next:hover b i{transform:none}
.cr{opacity:0}.cr.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.cs-back:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}.cs-next:hover{background:rgba(21,21,21,.025)}.cs-close:hover{opacity:.8}}
@media(max-width:900px){.cs-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px}.cs-title{font-size:clamp(44px,8vw,72px)}.cs-card .cbody{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.cs-side{gap:14px}.cs-meta{gap:8px 16px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.cs-bar{height:68px;padding:12px 20px}.cs-scroll{padding-top:68px}.cs-hero{padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:28px}.cs-title{font-size:clamp(42px,9vw,64px)}.cs-tags{font-size:18px}.cs-lead{font-size:15px}.cs-close{font-size:12px;gap:6px}.cs-close svg{width:18px;height:18px}.cs-meta{font-size:13px}.cs-sec{padding-top:36px}.cs-card p{font-size:15px}.cs-end{padding-top:24px}}
@media(max-width:420px){#top-nav .brand,.cs-home .brand{font-size:14px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cs,.cs *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}.cs-fade,.cs .cr{opacity:1;transform:none}}
body.paused .cs-fade,body.paused .cs .cr{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* Say olá: a compact contact footer with a Portuguese tile border. */
#footer.ola-footer{margin:40px clamp(12px,2vw,32px) clamp(12px,2vw,32px);padding:52px 0 0;background:#e8e4dd;color:var(--ink,#151515);border:1px solid rgba(21,21,21,.14);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden}
.ola-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1.4fr .6fr;align-items:start;gap:clamp(28px,3.6vw,60px);padding:0 clamp(24px,4vw,64px);max-width:1680px;margin:0 auto}
.ola-main>div,.ola-links{min-width:0}
.ola-intro h2{margin:0;font:600 clamp(48px,5.2vw,80px)/1.08 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.055em;white-space:nowrap}
.ola-intro h2 .ola-period{color:var(--red,#c93a26)}
.ola-intro p{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.ola-contact{padding-top:5px}
.ola-contact h3{margin:0 0 18px;font:500 clamp(21px,2vw,30px)/1.25 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.035em}
.ola-email{display:inline-block;max-width:100%;padding:2px 0 6px;color:inherit;font-size:clamp(16px,1.65vw,24px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ola-copy{margin-top:15px;min-height:44px}
.ola-links{display:grid;gap:10px}
.ola-links a,.ola-copy .copy-email{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#151515);font:400 15px/1.35 var(--body);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
.ola-links a{width:100%}
.ola-copy .copy-email{min-width:122px}
.ola-links a:hover,.ola-copy .copy-email:hover{background:rgba(21,21,21,.035);color:var(--ink,#151515)}
.ola-email:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px;color:inherit}
.ola-footer a:focus-visible,.ola-footer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#151515);outline-offset:5px}
.ola-bottom{position:relative;max-width:1680px;margin:0 auto;padding:36px clamp(24px,4vw,64px) 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.ola-bottom p{grid-column:2;margin:0;text-align:center}
.ola-bottom #pauseBtn{justify-self:end;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:8px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.ola-bottom #pauseBtn:disabled{cursor:default;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted)}
.ola-tiles{height:64px;background-color:var(--ink,#151515);background-repeat:repeat-x;background-position:center;background-size:1408px 64px}
.ola-voice{display:inline-block;position:relative;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:2px;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;line-height:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted rgba(21,21,21,.25);text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.12em}
.ola-voice:hover{text-decoration-color:currentColor}
.ola-a{display:inline-block;position:relative}
.ola-accent{position:absolute;inset:0;clip-path:inset(0 0 68% 0);pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% 25%}
.voice-playing .ola-accent{animation:ola-hat-hop 680ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.ola-voice-hint{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted,#4a4743)}
.ola-address{position:relative;width:fit-content;max-width:100%}
.footer-motion-ready .ola-email{text-decoration:none;background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) left bottom 4px/0 1px no-repeat;transition:background-size 750ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.footer-motion-ready.footer-seen .ola-email{background-size:100% 1px}
.footer-motion-ready .ola-email:hover{background-size:100% 2px}
.ola-copy{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px}
.ola-thanks{display:block;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;transition:opacity 180ms ease}
.ola-thanks>span:first-child{font-weight:500}
.ola-pronunciation{white-space:nowrap}
.has-receipt .ola-thanks{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
@keyframes ola-hat-hop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)}35%{transform:translateY(-.18em) rotate(-13deg)}67%{transform:translateY(.015em) rotate(5deg)}82%{transform:translateY(-.025em) rotate(-2deg)}}
.features-still .ola-accent{animation:none!important}
.features-still .ola-email,.features-still .ola-thanks{transition:none!important}
@media(max-width:420px){.ola-links a{padding-inline:6px;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ola-accent{animation:none!important}.ola-email,.ola-thanks{transition:none!important}}
@media(min-width:1680px){.ola-tiles{height:80px;background-size:1760px 80px}}
@media(max-width:1100px){.ola-main{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.35fr;gap:24px 36px}.ola-links{grid-column:2;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.ola-links a{padding-inline:10px}.ola-intro{grid-row:1/3}.ola-bottom{padding-top:30px}}
@media(max-width:760px){#footer.ola-footer{padding-top:32px}.ola-main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;padding-inline:24px}.ola-intro{grid-row:auto}.ola-intro h2{font-size:52px}.ola-intro p{margin-top:10px;font-size:15px}.ola-contact{padding-top:0}.ola-contact h3{font-size:23px;margin-bottom:12px}.ola-email{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.ola-copy{margin-top:12px}.ola-links{grid-column:auto;gap:8px}.ola-links a{font-size:14px;min-height:46px}.ola-bottom{padding:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 20px;font-size:12px}.ola-bottom p{text-align:left}.ola-bottom #pauseBtn{margin-left:auto}.ola-tiles{height:48px;background-size:1056px 48px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ola-footer a,.ola-footer button{transition:none}}

.ola-tiles{background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%221408%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%201408%2064%22%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3Cpattern%20id%3D%22tile%22%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20patternUnits%3D%22userSpaceOnUse%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20fill%3D%22%23191918%22%2F%3E%3Cg%20fill%3D%22%23ece9e4%22%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M0%200H32A32%2032%200%200%201%200%2032Z%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M32%200H64V32A32%2032%200%200%200%2032%200Z%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M0%2032V64H32A32%2032%200%200%200%200%2032Z%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M64%2032V64H32A32%2032%200%200%201%2064%2032Z%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fg%3E%3C%2Fpattern%3E%3C%2Fdefs%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%221408%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20fill%3D%22url%28%23tile%29%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M256%200H288A32%2032%200%200%201%20256%2032Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23c93a26%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M1216%2032V64H1248A32%2032%200%200%200%201216%2032Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23c93a26%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E")}

.ola-voice{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;text-decoration:none;gap:0}
.ola-speaker{align-self:center;transform:translateY(.08em);width:.34em;height:.34em;margin-left:.15em;flex:none;stroke-width:1.8}
.ola-voice:hover .ola-speaker{opacity:.72}
.ola-tiles{position:relative;touch-action:pan-y;background-color:#ece9e4;cursor:crosshair}
.ola-stones{position:absolute;left:0;width:100%;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.ola-tiles.stones-ready{background-image:none}
.features-still .ola-tiles{cursor:default}

/* Only visible if both browser clipboard methods are unavailable. */
.copy-manual{flex-basis:100%;min-width:0;margin-top:4px}
.copy-address{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:400 16px/1.5 var(--body);user-select:text}
.copy-address:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:3px}
.copy-hint{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.copy-buffer{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;border:0;opacity:0;font-size:16px;pointer-events:none}

/* One motion language. Geometry remains anchored to the existing composition. */
:root{--motion-out:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);--motion-travel:cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1);--motion-fast:180ms;--motion-standard:360ms;--motion-scene:560ms}
html{scrollbar-gutter:stable}
.portal,.portal.on{clip-path:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);filter:none;transition:opacity 520ms var(--motion-travel);will-change:auto}
.portal{opacity:0}.portal.on{opacity:1}
.portal .pv{opacity:0;filter:none;transform:none;transition:opacity 440ms var(--motion-travel)}
.portal .pv.show,.portal .pv.retained{opacity:1;filter:none;transform:none}
.portal::after{transition:none}
.media-screen:has(iframe)>img{visibility:visible}
.media-screen iframe{opacity:0;transition:opacity 240ms var(--motion-out)}
.media-screen[data-ready=true] iframe{opacity:1}
.dial button{transition:color 160ms ease,opacity 160ms ease}
.focus-ring-dial .marker{transition:transform 440ms var(--motion-out)}
.mmenu{transform-origin:top right;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.985);transition:opacity 180ms var(--motion-out),transform 220ms var(--motion-out),visibility 0s 220ms}
.mmenu.open{transform:none;transition-delay:0s}
.burger span{transition:transform 220ms var(--motion-out)}
.sound-consent{transform-origin:top right;animation:popover-in 200ms var(--motion-out) both}
.sound-consent.closing{animation:popover-out 150ms ease both;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes popover-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes popover-out{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-3px) scale(.99)}}
.cs-in{transition:opacity 320ms var(--motion-out),transform 440ms var(--motion-out);filter:none}
.cs.swap .cs-in{opacity:0;filter:none;transform:translateY(-12px);transition:opacity 180ms ease,transform 220ms ease}
.cs.preparing .cs-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:none}
.cs-title .tc{transition:transform 680ms var(--motion-out);transition-delay:calc(60ms + var(--i)*22ms)}
.cs-fade{transform:translateY(12px);transition:opacity 480ms var(--motion-out),transform 600ms var(--motion-out);transition-delay:calc(80ms + var(--d,0)*45ms)}
.cs.shown .cs-fade{transform:none}
.cs-next b{transition:transform 280ms var(--motion-out)}
.cs-next b i{transition:transform 280ms var(--motion-out)}
.cr{transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity 480ms var(--motion-out),transform 560ms var(--motion-out)}
.cr.in{transform:none}
.card,.rv,.xp{transition:opacity 480ms var(--motion-out),transform 620ms var(--motion-out);transform:none}
.card:nth-child(even){transition-delay:0s}
.motion-pending{opacity:1!important;transform:translateY(22px)!important}
.frame{transition:transform 360ms var(--motion-out),box-shadow 360ms var(--motion-out)}
.cap b::after{transition:transform 300ms var(--motion-out)}
.try::before{animation:none}
.btn-cs,.cap-cs,.open-project,.ola-links a,.copy-email{transition:background-color 160ms ease,opacity 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--motion-out)}
.btn-cs:active,.cap-cs:active,.open-project:active,.ola-links a:active,.copy-email:active{transform:scale(.985)}
.ola-thanks{transition:opacity 180ms ease,visibility 0s 180ms}
.has-receipt .ola-thanks{transition-delay:0s}
body.paused *,body.paused *::before,body.paused *::after{transition-duration:0s!important;transition-delay:0s!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.portal,.pv,.cs-in,.cs-title .tc,.cs-fade,.cr,.card,.rv,.xp,.mmenu,.sound-consent{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.motion-pending{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}}

.cs-bar{transition:background-color 320ms ease,color 220ms ease}
body.paused .motion-pending{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
body.paused .sound-consent{animation:none!important}
@media(hover:none){.cs-next:hover b,.cs-next:hover b i{transform:none}}

/* Editorial scale: the same composition, less competing presentation. */
.copy h1{letter-spacing:-.035em}
.dial button,.dlabel{font-style:normal}
